objective: Build and honestly verify all fifty shared Asset Hands upgrades for present and future human, AI and software hosts.
admission_rule: An upgrade becomes READY only when its native proof surface satisfies the declared pass condition and no required FAIL or UNKNOWN is hidden.

upgrades.title: Human visual-quality benchmark and promotion gate

acceptance.pass_condition: A digest-bound human review against declared references and criteria is required before technical candidates become promotion-eligible.
acceptance.primary_surface: human visual review receipt
acceptance.counterevidence: Technical scores or a machine vote can promote a candidate without human visual review.

acceptance.pass_condition: At least three real family members are generated from one style contract and pass technical, coherence and human visual review gates.
acceptance.primary_surface: generated family artifacts and coherence receipt
acceptance.counterevidence: The hand emits only a plan, or family members ignore the declared style contract.

upgrades.title: Generated hand-conformance matrix and descriptor linter

acceptance.pass_condition: Every installed descriptor field that makes a capability claim maps to schema-valid evidence and uncovered or contradictory claims fail conformance.
acceptance.primary_surface: parsed descriptors, schemas and test receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: An installed provider declares an output, operation or canvas without mapped evidence.

acceptance.pass_condition: Shared bounded operations edit compatible document models deterministically and undo or redo restores exact digest-bound state.
acceptance.primary_surface: operation replay and state digest assertions
acceptance.counterevidence: A failed operation partially mutates state or undo restores a different digest.

acceptance.pass_condition: Only hash-verified, licence-reviewed and version-compatible runtimes satisfy exact requests; absent or unreviewed runtimes remain visible.
acceptance.primary_surface: runtime inventory and package verification receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: A path, executable name or declared version alone marks a runtime READY.

acceptance.pass_condition: A minimal new host computes READY, MISSING_HAND or UNSUPPORTED_CANVAS routes and exact rejection reasons without hand-specific code.
acceptance.primary_surface: generic host negotiation fixtures
acceptance.counterevidence: A host needs an ID-specific branch to route an installed hand.
acceptance.secondary_surface: Asset Fabric, Studio and future-host parity test

upgrades.title: Round-trip import and export layer with loss ledger

acceptance.pass_condition: Each supported round trip retains the original source and reports preserved, declared-lost and unexpectedly-changed semantic facts.
acceptance.primary_surface: round-trip receipt and semantic comparison
acceptance.counterevidence: A lossy conversion reports success without a declared loss or source retention.

acceptance.pass_condition: Named workloads record duration, peak memory, output bytes and relevant domain budgets with environment and repetition metadata.
acceptance.primary_surface: measured benchmark receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: A general performance claim is inferred from one unnamed or unmeasured run.

upgrades.title: Shared fuzz, malformed-input and scene-stress corpus

acceptance.pass_condition: Deterministic corrupt, oversized, cyclic and path-hostile cases fail closed within declared time and memory bounds.
acceptance.primary_surface: bounded fuzz and stress execution receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: Any malformed case crashes the host, escapes its path boundary or silently succeeds.

acceptance.pass_condition: A signed external hand executes only its declared entrypoint and granted capabilities under time and output bounds, while tampered or revoked packages fail.
acceptance.primary_surface: signature, permission and sandbox adversarial tests
acceptance.counterevidence: Sandboxed code can access filesystem, process, network or undeclared host capabilities.

upgrades.title: Godot native asset adapter and runtime-performance gate

acceptance.pass_condition: A fresh Godot project imports, displays and exercises generated assets while proving material, animation, collision, memory and frame budgets.
acceptance.primary_surface: fresh Godot process and project receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: Only file parsing or a non-Godot preview is used as engine-import proof.
acceptance.secondary_surface: live rendered frames and measured runtime telemetry

acceptance.pass_condition: The same camera, light, material and geometry corpus is rendered by independent backends and compared under declared perceptual thresholds.
acceptance.primary_surface: multi-renderer captured frames and diff reports
acceptance.counterevidence: Material parity is inferred from one renderer or illustrative SVG previews.

acceptance.pass_condition: At least one non-Blender host passes signed apply, fresh-process inspect, changed-baseline protection and idempotent rollback.
acceptance.primary_surface: native host adapter transaction tests
acceptance.counterevidence: A host reports success without reopening and independently inspecting its saved project.
acceptance.secondary_surface: permission denial and crash recovery tests

acceptance.pass_condition: The reviewed official EPUBCheck runtime passes generated EPUB 3.3 and rejects a deliberately damaged publication.
acceptance.primary_surface: official EPUBCheck structured report
acceptance.counterevidence: The adapter contract or internal ZIP parser is presented as live EPUB conformance.

acceptance.pass_condition: A reviewed veraPDF runtime emits bound PDF/UA or PDF/A reports and rejects a known-invalid tagged document.
acceptance.primary_surface: veraPDF validation report
acceptance.counterevidence: Internal tagged-structure checks are relabelled PDF/UA conformance.

acceptance.pass_condition: A licence-reviewed independent ISO 15930 validator verifies generated PDF/X and rejects a known-invalid output-intent or page-box case.
acceptance.primary_surface: external PDF/X conformance report
acceptance.counterevidence: The bundled writer or pypdf structural corroboration certifies PDF/X.
acceptance.secondary_surface: print-operator review where machine checks are incomplete

acceptance.pass_condition: Independent tools verify dimensions, channels, bit depth, colour metadata, mip levels and thresholded pixel differences for supported images.
acceptance.primary_surface: OpenImageIO and OpenEXR tool reports
acceptance.counterevidence: Filename extensions or the producing codec are the only image evidence.

acceptance.pass_condition: Pinned OCIO configurations transform scene-linear masters to declared displays with numeric and rendered reference-image agreement.
acceptance.primary_surface: OCIO processor output and reference image comparison
acceptance.counterevidence: Colour-space labels change without transforming pixel values.

upgrades.title: glTF validator and Khronos render-fidelity corpus

acceptance.pass_condition: Generated glTF passes an independent validator and relevant Khronos material, animation, skin and compression render-fidelity cases.
acceptance.primary_surface: official validator report and rendered corpus diffs
acceptance.counterevidence: Only AXM's own GLB parser accepts the asset.

upgrades.title: KTX2 UASTC, HDR and transcoder matrix

acceptance.pass_condition: Official KTX tooling produces and transcodes UASTC and supported HDR profiles while decoded pixels and GPU budgets stay within declared thresholds.
acceptance.primary_surface: KTX reference tool and multi-target transcode receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: ETC1S output is relabelled UASTC or HDR without appropriate payloads.

acceptance.pass_condition: Schema-valid MaterialX 1.39 graphs generate for multiple backends and reference renders remain within declared material-specific thresholds.
acceptance.primary_surface: MaterialX validator, shader generation and renderer matrix
acceptance.counterevidence: A syntactically valid graph is assumed visually portable without backend execution.

acceptance.pass_condition: DTCG 2025.10 tokens, aliases, composite types and unknown extensions round-trip without semantic loss or type inference.
acceptance.primary_surface: DTCG fixture round trips and resolver assertions
acceptance.counterevidence: Unknown extensions disappear or types are guessed from values.

acceptance.pass_condition: Real keyboard, pointer and viewport journeys verify focus, target size, reflow, contrast, reduced motion and no hidden blocking state.
acceptance.primary_surface: live browser interaction journey
acceptance.counterevidence: Static schema or source inspection is presented as usability proof.
acceptance.secondary_surface: assistive technology or human accessibility review

upgrades.title: Interactive prototype, journey and state hand

acceptance.pass_condition: A generated prototype runs declared states and transitions under real inputs and exports an implementation handoff with accessibility evidence.
acceptance.primary_surface: live bounded prototype journey
acceptance.counterevidence: Static screenshots or component metadata are called an interactive prototype.

acceptance.pass_condition: Real bitmap layers, masks and adjustment stacks survive save, fresh-process reload and rerender with matching structure and pixels.
acceptance.primary_surface: project reopen plus independent image comparison
acceptance.counterevidence: Only a flattened PNG or declarative layer list exists.

upgrades.title: Pressure brush, ink and calligraphy engine

acceptance.pass_condition: Timestamped pressure and pointer samples replay into stable brush geometry and pixels under bounded smoothing and textured-tip rules.
acceptance.primary_surface: stroke replay and pixel comparison
acceptance.counterevidence: Pressure metadata is stored but has no effect on the rendered stroke.

upgrades.title: Selection, matting, retouch and controlled-warp hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Bounded selections, mattes, sampled repairs and warps modify only declared regions while retaining source and operation provenance.
acceptance.primary_surface: before, mask and after pixel assertions
acceptance.counterevidence: Pixels outside the declared region change or source sampling is unrecorded.

acceptance.pass_condition: Bezier edits and boolean operations produce finite, closed or intentionally open paths with stable bounds and parser-valid SVG output.
acceptance.primary_surface: geometry assertions and independent SVG parsing
acceptance.counterevidence: Operations emit self-intersections, NaN coordinates or invalid path syntax.
acceptance.secondary_surface: round-trip through a native vector host

acceptance.pass_condition: Variable strokes, gradients and blends render consistently in the reference matrix or record exact host-specific losses and fallbacks.
acceptance.primary_surface: cross-renderer vector corpus
acceptance.counterevidence: Unsupported appearance silently flattens or changes without a loss receipt.

acceptance.pass_condition: Paragraphs across representative scripts shape, break, align and subset without missing glyphs, clipped text or changed logical reading order.
acceptance.primary_surface: HarfBuzz glyph evidence and rendered paragraph corpus
acceptance.counterevidence: Glyph runs pass while paragraph layout clips or reorders content incorrectly.
acceptance.secondary_surface: native browser and PDF text extraction

acceptance.pass_condition: Multi-page content flows without loss across pages, tables and footnotes while reading order, page boxes and imposition remain verifiable.
acceptance.primary_surface: rendered page corpus and extracted structure
acceptance.counterevidence: The model supports one page or breaks logical reading order at page boundaries.

acceptance.pass_condition: Dielines, spot plates, overprint, trapping, separations and barcodes survive preflight and physical mock-up review for the declared process.
acceptance.primary_surface: formal preflight and separations inspection
acceptance.counterevidence: A screen preview is used as calibrated press or packaging proof.

acceptance.pass_condition: Repeat scale, colourway, grain, stretch, shrink and seam placement alter production outputs and material previews under declared fabric profiles.
acceptance.primary_surface: fabric production spec and mapped material renders
acceptance.counterevidence: Fabric behaviour is metadata added after an unchanged flat repeat.

upgrades.title: Garment pattern, grading and marker-layout hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Sized pattern pieces preserve seam allowances, notches, grain and matching edges while marker layout respects material width and repeat.
acceptance.primary_surface: geometric fit and marker assertions
acceptance.counterevidence: Pieces overlap, matched seams differ beyond tolerance or grain constraints are ignored.

acceptance.pass_condition: Artwork becomes bounded stitch paths with density, pull compensation, colour changes and machine limits verified by an independent parser or simulator.
acceptance.primary_surface: stitch simulation and container parser
acceptance.counterevidence: A vector preview is relabelled as embroidery machine output.

upgrades.title: Parametric B-rep CAD and STEP hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Constraint-driven sketches produce valid B-rep solids and STEP export that an independent CAD kernel reopens within declared geometric tolerances.
acceptance.primary_surface: independent CAD-kernel topology and tolerance checks
acceptance.counterevidence: A triangulated mesh is relabelled B-rep or STEP.

acceptance.pass_condition: Thickness, bend allowance, relief and tooling rules produce a flat pattern that refolds into the source part within tolerance.
acceptance.primary_surface: unfold and refold geometric comparison
acceptance.counterevidence: The flat pattern ignores bend allowance or cannot reconstruct the part.

acceptance.pass_condition: Watertight unit-aware material-aware 3MF packages pass official conformance tests and reopen with matching build objects and metadata.
acceptance.primary_surface: 3MF conformance suite and independent package reopen
acceptance.counterevidence: An STL-like mesh in a ZIP is called production 3MF.

upgrades.title: Verified CAM postprocessor and machine-profile system

acceptance.pass_condition: Machine-specific output binds post version, stock, fixtures and limits, passes independent simulation and still requires operator approval before execution.
acceptance.primary_surface: machine-profile simulation and approval receipt
acceptance.counterevidence: Generic or unapproved G-code is described as machine-ready.
acceptance.secondary_surface: bounded dry run on declared hardware

upgrades.title: High-to-low texture baking and tangent verification

acceptance.pass_condition: Normal, AO, curvature and packed maps reproduce the high-resolution source on the low mesh under the declared tangent convention and error bounds.
acceptance.primary_surface: bake maps, tangent checks and reference renders
acceptance.counterevidence: A procedural flat map is described as a high-to-low bake.

upgrades.title: Retopology, remesh, LOD and mesh-compression hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Descending LODs retain manifold topology, UV intent and declared silhouette error while independent decompression reproduces the encoded mesh.
acceptance.primary_surface: topology, error and decoder receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: Triangle reduction alone is used as LOD quality proof.

acceptance.pass_condition: Blend shapes, retargeted clips, IK/FK and root motion deform the reviewed visible mesh without invalid weights, drift or budget violations.
acceptance.primary_surface: deformation math and timestamped rendered frames
acceptance.counterevidence: Only a skeleton proxy moves while the reviewed character mesh remains unproven.

upgrades.title: Lighting, look-development, render and AOV hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Declared lights, cameras, exposure and materials render real beauty and AOV images whose recomposition matches the beauty within threshold.
acceptance.primary_surface: renderer outputs, AOV inspection and recomposition diff
acceptance.counterevidence: An illustrative diagram or material swatch is presented as a rendered scene.

upgrades.title: Simulation, particles, cloth, hair and destruction hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Seeded simulation settings and inputs reproduce bounded caches and visibly changing frames while invalid physics or budget states fail closed.
acceptance.primary_surface: simulation cache digests and frame sequence
acceptance.counterevidence: Static geometry or random frame changes are called a reproducible simulation.

upgrades.title: Terrain, tilemap, prefab and streamed-world hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Generated 2D or 3D regions stream in a native runtime with coherent placement, collision, navigation, spawn markers and measured budgets.
acceptance.primary_surface: native runtime traversal and streaming telemetry
acceptance.counterevidence: A static scene manifest is described as a working streamed world.

upgrades.title: Audible waveform, synthesis and playback hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Generated PCM and delivery audio decode through an independent implementation with matching duration, sample rate, channels, loudness and audible playback evidence.
acceptance.primary_surface: independent decoder measurements and playback capture
acceptance.counterevidence: MIDI or a visual waveform is presented as audible audio output.

upgrades.title: Audio editing, restoration, mixing and mastering hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Editable operations produce real stems and masters with verified timing, routing, loudness, true peak and no undeclared clipping or channel loss.
acceptance.primary_surface: decoded audio analysis and editable mix recipe
acceptance.counterevidence: Metadata changes without changing samples, or clipping is hidden by container success.

upgrades.title: MIDI 2.0, UMP, SMF2, MPE and hardware-profile hand

acceptance.pass_condition: UMP and clip data round-trip through an independent parser while MIDI-CI profiles negotiate exact device capabilities and preserve visible MIDI 1 fallback losses.
acceptance.primary_surface: protocol parser and simulated device exchange receipts
acceptance.counterevidence: MIDI 1 SMF events are relabelled MIDI 2.0 or hardware support is assumed.

upgrades.title: Video ingest, proxy, precision-edit and time-remap hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Source media, proxies and relinks retain timecode while ripple, roll, slip, multicam and variable-speed edits decode at expected frame timestamps.
acceptance.primary_surface: independent frame decode and timeline timestamp assertions
acceptance.counterevidence: A timeline recipe changes while decoded frames do not match the edit.

upgrades.title: Accessible video finishing and delivery hand

acceptance.pass_condition: Delivered video independently decodes synchronized picture, audio and captions with declared colour, loudness, timing, codec and file-size budgets.
acceptance.primary_surface: independent demux, decode, caption and loudness reports
acceptance.counterevidence: Silent video, external captions or container labels are presented as a finished accessible delivery.
